technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (MACD/PPO crossovers, RSI rising) show bullish intent, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with overbought stochRSI, limiting conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ADBE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 72 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (360.8), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 72 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD/PPO up, RSI rising) with extreme fear sentiment (27/100) create a contrarian entry near support (361.86) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally below all key moving averages (EMA21, SMA21, EMA50/200), Ichimoku cloud, with overbought stochRSI, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 72 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising USD, recession signals) make this a low-probability swing setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD/PPO) and extreme fear sentiment (27/100) create a contrarian setup, but structural price weakness below all key moving averages and zero fundamental catalysts make conviction too low for swing entry.
